senses.gloss:
गौण a. (णी f.) [गुणमधिकृत्य प्रवृत्ता गौणी, तत आगतः अण्]
—1 Subordinate, secondary, unessential; गुणवचनत्वाद् गौणः शब्दः
 ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 15.
—2 (In gram.) Indirect or less immediate (opp. मुख्य or प्रधान);
 गौणे कर्मणि दुह्यादेः प्रधाने नीहृकृष्वहाम् Sk.
—3 Figurative, metaphorical, used in a secondary sense (as a word or sense);
 तदा गौणमनन्तस्य नामानन्तेति विश्रुतम् Mb. 12. 182. 33.
—4 Founded on some resemblance between the primary and secondary sense
 of a word; as in गौणीलक्षणा.
—5 Relating to enumeration or multiplication.
—6 Attributive.

गौणिक a.
—1 Relating to the three qualities (सत्त्व, रजस् and तमस्); Ms. 12. 41.
—2 Having qualities.
—3 Subordinate.
—4 Resembling a sack.
गौण्यम् Subordination, inferior position or rank.
